summary: Appendix case study of Cisco (思科) daily 1997-2001 illustrating two traps: a false breakout (假突破) to a new high that quickly falls back below the neckline as a long-term sell signal, and the 'push-down distribution trap' (压低出货陷阱) where the launch zone (起涨区), normally the main player's cost base and strongest support, becomes the final distribution zone once institutions turn long-term bearish. Volume structure distinguishes accumulation volume (heavy volume followed by a big rally) from distribution volume (heavy volume followed by a further breakdown).

patterns.name_en: False breakout above a high-level consolidation
patterns.structure: After a long rally, price breaks out of a high-level consolidation (高档整理区) to a new high, then within about 2 weeks falls back below the neckline of that range.
patterns.entry: Sell/exit when price falls back below the neckline after the new-high breakout (book: '便又跌回颈线下极为明显的假突破长线卖出信号').

target.formula: Not given (no measured move in this unit)
target.worked_example: Cisco: high 82.00 on 2000/3/27, then fell to 50.00, bounced to 70.00, broke down; 2001 lows 13.19 and 11.04.

confirmation: Fall back below the neckline within ~2 weeks of the new high (Cisco).

patterns.name_zh: 压低出货陷阱（颈线支撑区压低出货）
patterns.name_en: Push-down distribution trap at the launch-zone support
patterns.structure: After a long decline (股价长期盘跌腰斩) price returns to the launch zone (起涨区, the start of the main player's cost), stabilises and rebounds/consolidates ~2 months (Cisco: 倒货区 / dumping zone). Heavy volume appears in this zone; price then breaks the launch-zone support and keeps falling.
patterns.entry: Book gives no explicit trigger; implied: treat the heavy volume at the launch-zone support as distribution once price breaks below that support and keeps making new lows (续破底大跌后便视为出货量).

target.worked_example: Cisco: support zone ~33-44 USD after halving from 82; broke down to 13.19 and 11.04 in 2001.

confirmation: Heavy-volume zone at the launch support followed by further breakdown = distribution volume.

rules.rule: A breakout of a high consolidation to a new high that falls back below the neckline within ~2 weeks is a very clear long-term sell signal (false breakout).
rules.quote_zh: 突破高档整理区创新高后约2周，便又跌回颈线下极为明显的假突破长线卖出信号。

rules.rule: The launch zone is usually viewed as the start of the main player's cost and thus strong support; but once institutions are long-term bearish it is the biggest push-down distribution trap.
rules.quote_zh: 通常起涨区附近视为一波主力作价成本起点，因此为相当大的支撑区，不过一旦法人长线看空，便是最大的压低出货陷阱。

rules.rule: Classify heavy volume by what follows: heavy volume followed by a big rally = accumulation volume; heavy volume at the launch support followed by a further breakdown = distribution volume.
rules.quote_zh: 1997年4月前后期间的大量在股价大涨后便视为进货量，当时股价约在6美元上下，2000年高点长期盘跌至年底跌回起涨大支撑区的大量，在股价续破底大跌后便视为出货量。

rules.rule: A stock that has halved is not necessarily cheap: institutions' long-held chips are still deeply profitable (sell anywhere and profit), so use volume-price structure (plus industry change) rather than 'bargain' reasoning.
rules.quote_zh: 当时股价即使腰斩，也仍约在33美元至44美元区间，法人主力长期的筹码仍是随便卖随便赚，因此除了产业的变化外，需注意量价结构来配合判断，以免以为捡了便宜，却陷入更大的风险之中。

worked_examples.pattern: 假突破 + 压低出货陷阱
worked_examples.outcome: ~15x rise to 82; false breakout ~2 weeks after new high; halved, consolidated ~2 months at launch-zone support (倒货区), then broke down to 13.19 and 11.04 in 2001.

quantifiable: False breakout: close above the high-consolidation range high (new N-bar high), then within ~10 trading days a close back below the range neckline -> long-term sell.

Launch-zone trap: after a >=50% decline from the high, price revisits the original launch-zone support; heavy volume there followed by a close below the zone's low and new lows => tag the heavy volume as distribution, bearish.
Volume classification: label a high-volume cluster 'accumulation' if subsequent N-bar return is strongly positive, 'distribution' if price subsequently breaks the cluster's low.
ambiguities: The chart's 起涨最大支撑 dashed line and the 倒货区 are drawn but no numeric support level is printed; text gives only the 33-44 USD range.
No entry/stop/target rules for shorting the trap are given; the lesson is mostly about avoiding a long at the launch support.
The '红色虚框' (red dashed boxes) referenced in the text appear only as circled volume areas in the grayscale scan.
Prices are split-adjusted (82 vs 146.75 pre-split); other chart labels (7.58, 17.55, 10.28) are not explained in the text.
